timeline.summary: Promoter **PROMOTER** (Uttam Sugar Mills Limited) disclosed no encumbrance on shares held during FY2025-26 ending March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹470.1 Cr (-17.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹54.76 Cr (-16.8% YoY).
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of Rs. 2.50 per equity share on May 15, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹494 Cr (-15.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4.48 Cr.
Uttam Sugar Mills filed results presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
